opportunities.title: Your Hardware Wallet Was Never the Weak Link — The Coldcard Hacker's Exit Route Was
opportunities.why_now: The Coldcard theft only became 'real' once the stolen BTC hit THORChain for an ETH swap, exposing the actual laundering rail attackers rely on.
opportunities.angle: Forensic breakdown of the swap path — argue self-custody security theater ends where cross-chain liquidity begins; tie to why THORChain keeps showing up in hack post-mortems

opportunities.title: Lazarus Just Ran $30M Through Hyperliquid — Perps Are the New Mixer
opportunities.why_now: DPRK-linked addresses moving through a top perp DEX signals laundering has moved from bridges to derivatives venues, a structural shift security desks need to price in now.
opportunities.angle: Explainer on why perp DEXs are becoming preferred laundering infrastructure; checklist for what compliance teams should be watching on Hyperliquid-style venues

opportunities.title: Tether Froze $42M to Stop a Scam — Now the Victims Are Suing Tether
opportunities.why_now: This is the first major test case of whether Tether's freeze powers protect victims or just create new legal liability, with real money and real plaintiffs.
opportunities.angle: Legal/security explainer: what Tether's freeze actually does, why 'centralized stablecoin as fraud backstop' cuts both ways, and what it means for anyone relying on issuer intervention

opportunities.title: Full Sail Is Dead Because an Oracle Was Wrong — Again
opportunities.why_now: A Sui DeFi protocol just wound down entirely because of a Switchboard oracle incident, another entry in the growing pile of 'oracle failure kills protocol' case studies.
opportunities.angle: Pattern-recognition piece: catalog oracle-triggered protocol deaths, argue this is the most underpriced risk vector in DeFi right now, not smart contract bugs

opportunities.title: Ukraine Busted a $1M/Month Drainer Ring — Yours Is Still Live
opportunities.why_now: Law enforcement just confirmed the scale of organized wallet-drainer operations, a concrete number that makes the abstract threat immediate and quantifiable.
opportunities.angle: Practical security piece: how drainer kits actually work, why busts like this barely dent the supply chain, and what signing hygiene actually prevents it
